edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the source address into transferFrom by transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender when checking and decrementing allowance.
delegate gate require(msg.sender == owner) controls execution of arbitrary bytecode.
init gate require(msg.sender == owner) controls sale parameter configuration.
batchSend gate require(msg.sender == owner) controls batch minting.
setTradeAddress gate require(msg.sender == owner) controls the trade whitelist.
owner is initialized from msg.sender in the constructor.
approve writes allowance for msg.sender as owner.
ensure compares _from and _to against the owner address whitelist.
owner authorization is required before the delegatecall is executed.
owner authorization is required before init mutates sale configuration.
owner authorization is required before batchSend transfers balances.
owner authorization is required before tradeAddress is updated.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom requires ensure to succeed before moving balances.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf and allowance subtraction and addition.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments the per-address sale counter.
ensure invokes condition for sale limit validation.
ensure uses pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair whitelist address.
ensure reads tradeAddress for the whitelist bypass.
ensure reads canSale for the whitelist bypass.
ensure reads the owner address for the whitelist bypass.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition reads _minSale to bound the minimum amount.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the maximum amount.
condition reads _onSaleNum for the per-address sale count.
init multiplies token amounts by 10**decimals without overflow checks.
init writes the computed minimum sale amount.
init writes the computed maximum sale amount.
init writes the sale count configuration.
batchSend multiplies _value by _tos.length without overflow checks.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf without SafeMath.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
constructor assigns the deployer as owner.
constructor sets the total supply.
constructor credits the deployer balance.
constructor sets an unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
approve writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender.
delegate executes an arbitrary external delegatecall into caller supplied bytecode.
The unchecked arithmetic directly mutates balanceOf balances.
_to parameter flows into transfer and onward to transferFrom.
_value parameter flows into transfer and onward to transferFrom.
_from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
_to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
_value parameter is used in unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
_spender parameter is the approval target in approve.
_value parameter is the allowance amount written in approve.
Target address a is the delegatecall destination in delegate.
Calldata b is the delegatecall payload in delegate.
saleNum parameter configures _saleNum in init.
token parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals in init without checks.
maxToken parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals in init without checks.
_tos array length is multiplied into the unchecked total in batchSend.
_value parameter is multiplied into the unchecked total and added to balances.
addr parameter is written into tradeAddress.
_from parameter is compared against the whitelists in ensure.
_to parameter is compared against the owner whitelist in ensure.
_value parameter is forwarded to condition in ensure.
Locally computed _UNI pair address is consumed by the ensure whitelist check.
Locally computed total from unchecked multiplication is used in batchSend deductions.
Loop index i drives the batchSend distribution loop.
